methods.interpretation: Descriptive diagnostic associations; not causal timing or treatment effects.
methods.population: Train, D14-eligible, randomized no-contact control customers.
methods.cohort_maturity: All controls in a displayed cohort must pass their 90-day label freeze; otherwise all cells are null.
methods.segment_denominator: Control customers with settled 90-day labels; unobserved outcomes are never zero.
methods.km_estimator: Kaplan-Meier; events before censoring at tied times.
methods.km_censoring: Administrative min(60 days, as_of - assigned_at); unsubscribe does not censor purchases.
methods.km_interval: Pointwise Greenwood log-log survival interval, transformed to 1-S(t).
methods.at_risk_convention: Immediately before each named time, including same-time events and censors.
methods.unsupported_tail: Values after largest observed duration are null; no extrapolation.
methods.uncertainty_scope: Sampling uncertainty within the fixed synthetic world, not real-market uncertainty.
